LESSON: SCANNING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.2 Speed Reading (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the learner
Topic 2.9: Scanning for information

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Scanning for information. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can you improve your reading fluency?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify specific information for comprehension
2. read given texts fluently for communication

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify specific information for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can identify specific information for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. read given texts fluently for communication
   In simple words: practise until you can read given texts fluently for communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Scanning for information using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Scanning for information in the examples.
2. Explain Scanning for information to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Scanning for information.
4. Show that you can: identify specific information for comprehension

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Scanning for information using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Scanning for information important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen to and read along audio texts of peers talking about daily routine at home (z.B. Ich stehe um 7 Uhr auf; ich esse um 7.30 mein Frühstück; usw),
2. Read short texts about what people do routinely at home and carry out given tasks
3. Listen to and read along texts of peers talking about daily routine at school (z.B. Ich lerne um/ab 9.20 Mathe; Ich spiele am Nachmittag Fußball; usw),
4. Read short texts about what people do routinely at school,
5. Read to peers own text about routines at home and school and compare,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify specific information for comprehension
2. read given texts fluently for communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
